description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the EmployeeTerminationAPI class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing CRUD operations related to employee termination records via API endpoints.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationAPITest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeTerminationAPI endpoints, including delete, get, create, and update functionalities, with validation rule tests.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Loads fixture data for testing from a YAML file.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests the deletion of an employee termination record and verifies behavior with existing and non-existing records.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies validation rules for the delete operation, including permissions.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests that the getAll method is not implemented and raises an exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Ensures getValidationRuleForGetAll raises the expected exception.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a specific employee termination record and handling of not-found cases.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Checks validation rules for getting a record.

methods.name: testCreateWithRecordNotFound
methods.description: Tests create operation when the employee does not exist, expecting a not found exception.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creation of a new employee termination record and verifies its correctness.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Verifies the validation rules for creating a record.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing employee termination record.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Verifies validation rules for the update operation.
